name: notification
notes: Per-recipient notification events. Emitted (op I) from NotificationService::persist_notification when a notification row is created, in the same transaction as the insert. Scoped to the recipient's private 'user:<uuid>' group so only that user's clients receive it; this is what makes notifications cross-machine (Postgres NOTIFY) rather than the prior in-process broadcast. The data payload carries enough to toast and to invalidate the notifications list/unread-count queries; clients refetch the authoritative list. aggregate_id is the notification's numeric id.
